serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I lost…
Big Daddy: Oh~ little one…
Big Daddy: It seems like you are not ready to shake off these thoughts just yet. Better luck next time!
You: I will try, but is there really a point? 
Big Daddy: Come on! You can’t give up now! I believe in you.
You: Thanks Big Daddy, I can always count on you…
